title: Lineup of Humphrey's band with T-Boy on trumpet
summary: Humphrey names band members including Joe Welsh, Eddie Dawson, T-Boy and Arthur Williams.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, he was one of the best around here. I only knew him as a trumpet player. He used to take him trumpet after. Who was your trumpet player in your band?

Well, T-Boy. Oh, when you had your band. Yeah, well I was playing with that line up, see? Joe Welsh, Eddie Dawson, Abbe Kearney, T-Boy, a little fellow named Arthur Williams, and Kearney. That kind of bad eye. I didn't see his name in that book. He was pretty good, too. Arthur Williams.
